title: Crispy Peanut Brittle
description: A sweet and crunchy Chinese-inspired dessert made with peanuts and crispy elements.
instructions: Spread the peanuts on a baking sheet and toast for 5-7 minutes, or until fragrant.
In a large saucepan, combine the brown sugar, honey, soy sauce, and vegetable oil. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the sugar dissolves.
Add the crispy rice cereal and brittle to the saucepan and stir until well combined.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in the toasted peanuts.
Pour the mixture onto a greased surface and let cool and set.
Break the mixture into pieces and serve.
